🎥🎬: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The legendary Vermont State Troopers are back, bringing their signature blend of outrageous pranks, unforgettable one-liners, and total roadside chaos. As the crew reunites for another wild adventure, old rivalries resurface, ridiculous situations spiral out of control, and the laughs keep coming from start to finish.

With the return of the beloved cast, nostalgic callbacks, and the offbeat humor that made the franchise a cult comedy favorite, Super Troopers 3 delivers another hilarious chapter packed with absurd antics and fan-favorite moments.

Watch #SuperTroopers on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
